standard_prerequisites.use: Give the two quasi-isomorphisms from the Hom-complex colimit to the alternated Cech total complex and to R Gamma(U, F-bullet).

standard_prerequisites.name: Hom out of the dual Koszul resolution in D(A)

standard_prerequisites.use: H^0 of the Hom-complex computes Hom in D(A).

core_obligations: Represent E by a quasi-coherent complex F-bullet with M-bullet = Gamma(X, F-bullet) via the affine comparison lemma.
Display the quasi-isomorphism chain colim_e Hom-bullet(I-bullet(f_1^e,...,f_r^e), M-bullet) -> Tot(Cech_alt(U, F-bullet)) -> R Gamma(U, F-bullet) from the two same-chapter lemmas.
Take H^0: by the More on Algebra lemma, H^0 of the Hom-complex computes Hom in D(A), yielding colim_e Hom_{D(A)}(I-bullet(f_1^e,...,f_r^e), M-bullet) = H^0(U, E).
Translate back through the affine comparison lemma: Hom_{D(A)}(I-bullet(f^e), M-bullet) = Hom_{D(O_X)}(I_e, E); conclude the comparison map of equation-comparison is an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Affine representation; quasi-isomorphism chain; H^0 computes Hom; translation back to sheaf Hom.
difficulty_reason: A comparison-isomorphism proof assembled from two Cech-computations inputs and one algebra identification; each step is named and carried.
